scoring: ordered sum over # + complete vector + #; normalize by phoneCount+1; no null deletion
groups: English total and exact phone counts
generated total, each profile and stream, each with exact phone counts
nested generated source-identity-complete view in every group
summary: independently sorted sequential binary64 means; upper-middle median; min/max; exact sign counts; null empty groups
witnesses: first row per changed support category/missing/ambiguous/unknown; maximum abs(total delta), first tie; separate English/generated
acceptance: review source/fixtures/Python verifier/CLI matrix before any full scoring
two fresh complete outputs exactly identical under the same pinned engine
independent full-row raw-source reconstruction under frozen tolerances
no generator calls, sealed validation, live gate changes or adoption
sourcePolicy: all parent tracked files plus explicit new study paths and external inputs; extra matching study source files rejected; outputs outside checkout/inputs; externally supplied freeze byte SHA required
publication: fresh directory, exclusive files, completed report written last only after all source/input/post guards; failures retained as incomplete
